name: SurveyPlanet
description_en:
SurveyPlanet is an online survey service for building a questionnaire, sharing its link or embedding it, and viewing responses. Its free plan explicitly allows unlimited surveys, questions and responses with basic in-app reports. That makes the important boundary access to advanced workflow and data handling rather than simply the number of submitted answers.

Pro adds branching and exports; Enterprise adds team sharing, survey insights and API access. A project needing raw responses in another system therefore has a different plan requirement from someone reading a basic results chart inside the service. AI survey generation and AI result analysis also sit in different paid tiers.
description_zh:
SurveyPlanet 用于在线创建问卷、分享链接或嵌入网页，并查看回答。免费方案明确允许不限问卷、题目和回答，提供基础应用内报表。因此，关键边界在于高级流程与数据处理权限，而不只是提交回答数量。

Pro 增加分支和导出，Enterprise 增加团队共享、问卷洞察及 API。需要把原始回答交给其他系统的项目，与只在平台查看基础图表的人，需要不同套餐。AI 生成问卷与 AI 分析结果也分属不同付费层级。

core_features.explanation_en: Free includes surveys, questions, responses and basic in-app reports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 免费包括问卷、题目、回答和基础应用内报表。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro branches use answer conditions to skip, jump, end or disqualify.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 按答案条件跳过、跳转、结束或取消参与资格。

en: Collect an online questionnaire and export the raw results on a paid plan.
zh: 收集在线问卷，并在付费套餐导出原始结果。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Build a survey, choose the player format and share a test link.
steps.zh: 创建问卷，选择显示方式并分享测试链接。

steps.en: For Pro branching, test end versus disqualify and recheck branches after editing choices.
steps.zh: 使用 Pro 分支时，测试结束与取消资格的区别，修改选项后重新核对。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: USD subscription per license/tier; bulk license discounts.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free supports unlimited surveys, questions and responses. Pro: USD $20/month or $180/year. Enterprise: $350/year; multi-license discounts are separate. Exports and branching require Pro; API and Teams require Enterprise.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费支持不限问卷、题目和回答。Pro 为美元月付 $20 或年付 $180；Enterprise 年付 $350，批量许可另计折扣。导出与分支需 Pro，API 和团队需 Enterprise。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Start with a distribution and reporting decision
sections.title_zh: 先决定分发与报表方式
sections.en: SurveyPlanet supports survey links, social sharing and iframe embedding. Free provides basic summaries, while Pro adds Word, Excel, CSV, JSON and PDF-summary exports. For an illustrative staff questionnaire, first decide whether the owner needs only an in-app chart or individual records for another analysis tool. Unlimited responses do not imply free raw-data portability.
sections.zh: SurveyPlanet 支持问卷链接、社交分享和 iframe 嵌入。免费提供基础摘要，Pro 增加 Word、Excel、CSV、JSON 及 PDF 摘要导出。例如员工问卷，先决定负责人只需应用内图表，还是需要逐条记录交给其他分析工具。回答不限不代表原始数据可免费导出。

sections.title_zh: 理解取消资格会丢弃什么
sections.en: Pro branching can combine any or all conditions. End survey submits answers already given, while disqualify participant discards all answers. Conflicting go-to actions follow only the last created action. After editing answer choices, inspect the Branches view for invalid-branch warnings: a condition matching an old answer label may never become true. Test the retained data as well as what the respondent sees.
sections.zh: Pro 分支可组合“任一”或“全部”条件。结束问卷会提交已有答案，取消参与资格则丢弃全部答案。冲突的跳转仅执行最后创建的动作。修改选项后，应在分支视图检查无效警告：匹配旧选项文字的条件可能永远无法成立。既要检查受访者看到的内容，也要检查保留下来的数据。

sections.title_en: Pay for capabilities rather than a response allowance
sections.title_zh: 按能力而非回答额度购买
sections.en: The pricing page states USD $20 monthly or $180 yearly for Pro, with branching, export, custom themes and AI survey creation. Enterprise is $350 yearly and adds Teams, API, Insights and AI result analysis. Bulk licenses have separate discounts; a team-sharing feature does not establish unlimited licensed accounts. The free plan is ongoing, not merely a trial.
sections.zh: 定价页明确美元计价，Pro 月付 $20 或年付 $180，包含分支、导出、自定义主题和 AI 创建问卷。Enterprise 年付 $350，增加团队、API、Insights 和 AI 结果分析。批量许可另有折扣，团队共享不证明授权账户数不限。免费方案为持续使用，不仅是试用。

sections.title_en: Check the analysis and operating boundary
sections.en: SurveyPlanet merits evaluation for straightforward online questionnaires with a clear free-versus-export tradeoff. The page labels a kiosk capability, but this does not establish offline capture. No self-hosted package or open-source license was verified. Validate one skipped answer and one disqualified response before a consequential study; AI suggestions and result interpretations need human review. We did not create a survey or exercise export, deletion or API access.
sections.zh: 对于在线问卷，以及明确权衡免费收集与付费导出的需求，可以评估 SurveyPlanet。页面列有自助终端能力，但这不能证明离线采集。本次未确认自托管服务包或开源许可。重要研究前建议核对一条跳题回答及一条取消资格回答，AI 建议和解释仍需人工复核。本文未创建问卷，也未执行导出、删除或 API。

research_gaps: No survey, branching, export, AI analysis, kiosk or API was executed.
Exact retention, source license, self-hosting, bulk-team account rights and administrator languages remain unverified.
